title: Intensifier Classification Mind Map
subject: Polity
caption: Mind‑map showing how intensifiers modify adjectives, adverbs, and verbs with common examples.
altText: A diagram with a central node labeled Intensifiers branching to three categories: Adjectives, Adverbs, and Verbs. Each category further branches to example intensifier words such as very, extremely, utterly for adjectives; so, really for adverbs; and completely, absolutely for verbs.
